title: Inner cost of queried estimation
statement: For a finite family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a natural number $m$, the estimator's inner cost uses no random examples, charges $|\mathcal F|m$ membership queries, and charges $|\mathcal F|m+|\mathcal F|m(n+1)$ units of work.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
